# nomatron_oidc_provider (Data Source)

Fetch a single Nomatron OIDC provider by slug.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nomatron_oidc_provider" "google" {
  slug = "google"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `slug` (String) OIDC provider slug.

### Read-Only

- `allowed_email_domains` (List of String) Email domain allow-list.
- `auto_provision` (Boolean) Whether valid first-time OIDC logins auto-create Nomatron users.
- `client_id` (String) OIDC client ID.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable provider name.
- `email_claim` (String) Claim used for the user's email address.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this provider can be used for login.
- `groups_claim` (String) Claim containing external group values.
- `id` (String) OIDC provider ID.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this provider is the default OIDC login provider.
- `issuer_url` (String) OIDC issuer URL.
- `name_claim` (String) Claim used for the display name.
- `scopes` (List of String) OIDC scopes requested during login.
- `sync_groups` (Boolean) Whether external group claims synchronize mapped RBAC assignments at login.
- `sync_profile` (Boolean) Whether profile fields are synchronized at login.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the provider was last updated.
- `username_claim` (String) Claim used for the Nomatron username.
